Oink 0.3.7 fixes several stability and usability issues. If Oink on Windows can't start or uninstall after updating to 0.3.6, download and run the 0.3.7 installer manually to repair it

New

When Oink on Windows or Mac runs into a startup problem, it now explains the cause and what to do;

Fixes

Fixed "The system cannot find the file specified (os error 2)" and being unable to connect to the backend when opening Oink over Remote Desktop on Windows (#58);
Fixed Oink on Windows reporting "input service identity verification failed" after an unfinished in-app update, and then being unable to update or uninstall (#41);
Fixed a leftover update process on Windows staying alive after an in-app update failed midway, which made later installs and uninstalls fail;
Fixed trackpad gestures forwarded from other devices (switching desktops, Mission Control, etc.) not working on macOS 27;
Fixed the Oink main window on Mac not supporting system window tiling;

Compatibility: 0.3.7 can connect to 0.3.0 and later.

## Downloads

- **Mac (Apple silicon):** the `.dmg` file — macOS 14.2 or later.
- **Mac (Intel):** the `.dmg` file marked `x64` — macOS 14.2 or later.
- **Windows:** the `.msi` file — x64, Windows 10 version 1809 (build 17763) or later, or Windows 11. Windows 10 versions before 22H2 are untested.
